basic_info.description: Located in one of SF's most vibrant neighborhoods, this condo has it all! This gorgeous 3bed 1bath condo boasts original features throughout including coved ceilings, built-ins and a clawfoot tub. Beautifully remodeled, well-appointed kitchen w/ stainless appliances and glass backsplash. Also featuring, a formal dining area with built-ins and seating in the bay windows. Convenient laundry room w/ a washer/dryer and utility basin. The building is surrounded by a huge, lush garden w/ mature vegetation - an oasis ideal for lounging or big BBQ parties. In addition, this property comes w/ TWO private garages - one located on Capp Street and one located off the back of the garden and accessed off Lilac Ally Walk Score of 99, everything you could want is just out your door, buses, BART, shopping, parks, bars entertainment & tons of good eats! Near the 101 and 280.
